body: The 2.8K 90Hz OLED display is absolutely breathtaking for movies and text editing.
Battery backup dropped significantly when display set to 90Hz; averages about 7 hours instead of 12.5 hours.
Featherlight 1.32kg all-aluminum chassis makes carrying it across campus super easy.
Experienced thermal throttling under heavy multitasking when running Android Studio emulator and Docker simultaneously.
Fan noise under dual compiler load is noticeable in a quiet library, but temps stay under 85C.
